author: jade-cho
title: NPU Models Tests fail with KeyError on aten.upsample_vec ops not in decomp table
signature: keyerror opoverload op aten upsample vec not found in decomp table|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: NPU Models Tests / 3720
failed_jobs.symptom: JAX/Flax Models Tests - NPU compile-only step failed due to KeyError on aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec and aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec not in PyTorch FX decoder decomp table

key_errors: WARNING:root:Operation aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec not found in decomp table
File: openvino/frontend/pytorch/fx_decoder.py, line 290, in from_exported_program: cls._decomp_table.pop(op)
WARNING:root:Operation aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec not found in decomp table
root_cause: The NPU Models Tests / 3720 job attempted to pop 'aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec' and 'aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec' from the PyTorch FX decoder decomp table during JAX/Flax model testing, but these ops were not present in the table for this PyTorch version on Windows. Despite the KeyErrors, the actual tests passed (4 passed, 7 skipped). The job is marked failure because the JAX/Flax step exits with a non-zero code due to the exception. This is a pre-existing intermittent issue with the decomp table pop logic in fx_decoder.py on certain PyTorch versions on Windows. The PR changes (GPU PagedAttention micro-SDPA fix) are completely unrelated to NPU/JAX/PyTorch frontend code.
reproduction_steps: Run JAX/Flax model tests targeting NPU on Windows with a PyTorch version that does not include aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec and aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec in the default decomp table.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs - this failure is unrelated to the PR changes (GPU SDPA) and is a known intermittent issue
Long-term fix: update fx_decoder.py to use a safe pop (e.g., cls._decomp_table.pop(op, None)) instead of a bare pop that raises KeyError when the op is absent
Track the issue in the OpenVINO PyTorch FE: ensure the WARNING log does not translate to a hard failure when decomp table entries are simply missing
prevention_strategies: Guard cls._decomp_table.pop(op) in fx_decoder.py with a presence check or use .pop(op, None) to avoid raising KeyError when ops are absent from the decomp table in some PyTorch versions.
historical_context: This same failure was previously observed on 2026-08-26 in run 33018808355 (PR #37611). The signature is identical: aten.upsample_nearest2d.vec and aten.upsample_bilinear2d.vec KeyError from fx_decoder.py line 290.
